_comment: DESADV (DELIVERY_REQUEST_OUT) Equipment lookup. From configured-production.md (MM_CO_EDI_DELIVERY_REQUEST_OUT__2__DESADV and the *_cdm / *_cdm_6 variants): API_EQUIPMENT, filter `MaintObjectFreeDefinedAttrib eq '%s'`, key fed from /ns0:DeliveryRequest/Delivery/HandlingUnit/ID, returns the Equipment number. EntitySet 'Equipment' (EntityType EquipmentType, Schema cds_api_equipment) confirmed from API_EQUIPMENT.edmx; MaintObjectFreeDefinedAttrib + Equipment are both Edm.String properties present on the type. Generate: gen-lookups <outdir> <this> <cpi-lookup-template/skeleton/LOOKUP_TEMPLATE>

lookups.name: LOOKUP_EQUIPMENT_HU
lookups.description: DESADV: resolve the Equipment number from API_EQUIPMENT by the handling-unit external ID carried in MaintObjectFreeDefinedAttrib (PI key <- /DeliveryRequest/Delivery/HandlingUnit/ID, filter MaintObjectFreeDefinedAttrib eq '%s', result param Equipment). EntitySet Equipment has a composite key (Equipment, ValidityEndDate) so a HU can map to several validity slices; consumer takes the first/current.
